title: erigeron thunbergii subsp. angustifolius
intro: Erigeron thunbergii subsp. angustifolius, commonly known as Western Fleabane, is a plant species native to western North America. As a medicinal herb, Western Fleabane has been used to treat various health conditions due to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties, which provide relief from pain, fever, and respiratory issues. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its therapeutic actions. Western Fleabane has been traditionally used to treat coughs, colds, and other respiratory problems, as well as to soothe skin irritations and wounds.
